text: Good evening ma, please I am so sorry to be disturbing you this late, desculpa. I am the aunt of Adaeze, she is 11. Her temperature is 39.4 and she has been hot since yesterday. Tonight I saw some spots and I pressed a glass on them like they say, and they did not go. Non-blanching, abeg, they are still there. Her skin is very dark so it was hard to see on her arms, so I checked her palms, the soles of her feet and inside her mouth, and I can see the little dark dots there clearly. Meu Deus. Her breathing is also not correct at all. She is breathing very fast and I can see the place under her ribs sucking in each time, and she is making a small grunting sound. Her mother is travelling and I don't want to overreact but I am really worried, por favor what should I do. Sorry again for the trouble
